title: Herbaceous Portuguese Pork Roast
description: A silky, earthy pork roast infused with hoisin, shio‑koji cure, and Portuguese herbs, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Pat the pork roast dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, combine shio‑koji, hoisin sauce, olive oil, minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, paprika, and pepper.
Rub the seasoning mixture all over the pork roast, pressing into the surface.
Heat a heavy skillet over medium‑high heat and sear the roast on all sides until browned, about 3 minutes per side.
Place the seared roast into a roasting pan, add the bay leaf and pour chicken broth around the meat.
Roast in the preheated oven for 90 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Remove the roast from the oven and tent loosely with aluminum foil, letting it rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the roast thinly against the grain.
Serve the slices with a drizzle of the pan juices and optional fresh herbs.
